name: manual_f4f941
claim: Clear a stale gbrain autopilot.lock only after verifying its recorded PID is dead and no sync or autopilot process is live, then run the sync in the background with a timeout guard

decisions.notes: A dead autopilot PID leaves autopilot.lock behind and blocks every later sync with lock-held errors; long repo syncs exceed an interactive shell ceiling so they must run under nohup with a bounded timeout and a log to poll.

rationale: A dead autopilot PID leaves autopilot.lock behind and blocks every later sync with lock-held errors; long repo syncs exceed an interactive shell ceiling so they must run under nohup with a bounded timeout and a log to poll.
